shared_formulas.vanilla_armor: damage_after_armor = damage * (1 - clamp(armor - damage / (2 + toughness / 4), armor / 5, 20) / 25)

shared_formulas.absorption: absorbs final health damage until absorption hearts are exhausted
shared_formulas.shield: cancels a blockable hit before health loss; bypasses_shield damage is not blocked
